title: docs(permissions): under record sharing a predicate write is bounded by the write scope
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9D7K4emLL9dNcp4rQPn22Dw)_

Fixes #34219

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 只改三处权限文档：在启用记录共享时，批量（`multi: true`）更新或删除只写调用者按共享**可写**的行;只读共享的行即使应用的 update 放宽规则放行，批量写也不碰它、不报错，按 id 单独写才行。
- **为什么改：** 文档原来说批量写能放宽到「调用者能读到的行」,与 #34033 之后引擎的实际行为不符，按文档写规则的作者会以为批量写改到了只读共享的行。
- **风险与回滚：** 无行为变化，纯文档。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx` 新增段;`permissions-matrix.mdx` 性能提示里加的一句;`releases/v17/17-2.mdx` 迁移表第一行的补句。
- **两分钟验证：** 打开 `/docs/permissions/rls`,在「A write widener never reaches a row the caller cannot read」段后能看到「Under record sharing, a predicate write is bounded by the write scope」。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`: a new paragraph after the write-widener floor. With record sharing composed, a predicate (`multi: true`) `update` / `delete` on a `private` object writes only the rows the caller may write: owner depth and queue, plus edit shares for an update (a share never grants delete, ADR-0111 D3). A row held only through a read share, which an app `update` widener admits, is left as it was and the write answers no error. Addressing it by id alone writes it. A scalar `id` beside other keys under `multi: true`, and a falsy `id`, run as predicate writes and meet the same bound (the two shapes PR #34033 moved, per its BREAKING note).
- `content/docs/permissions/permissions-matrix.mdx`: the predicate-write sentence in the performance tip gains the same bound and remedy.
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-2.mdx`: the migration row that prescribes `multi: true` for `{ where: { id, …other } }` now says that, under record sharing, that form is a predicate write bounded by the write scope, and points at the by-id remedy.

Sources for every sentence: PR #34033's BREAKING text and its measured table (`update { id, stage: 'open' }` on a read-shared row admitted only by the app RLS widener: base 1 row written, head no error, 0 rows; `{ where: { id } }`: written), ADR-0111 D3, and contract record 6904564182 (M1).

## Tests

Docs only. No test changed.

## Acceptance notes

- None.
